Marco (Willow): Hey team — we got a request from Willow to onboard a custom embedding model for product search. They want higher recall on short queries and PHI-safe handling. Can we map next steps?
Aisha (CSM): Thanks Marco — they're on the renewal conversation next quarter so we want this smooth. Quick Q: do they need Dedicated or Private?
Marco (Willow): Prefer Private (VPC) for compliance. They also asked about key rotation/HSM.
Jin (SolutionsEng): Got it. For embeddings, do we have a target throughput and vector size?
Marco (Willow): Target 100 rps, 1536-dim vectors. Latency SLO ~50ms p95.
Priya (Safety): PHI-safe handling means we need token-level redaction and a safety eval suite. Can Willow provide labeled sensitive spans?
Marco (Willow): They can share a redaction spec and a small labeled set (200 examples) next week.
Aisha (CSM): Action items: 1) Jin to validate model compatibility and perf estimate 2) Priya to design safety eval + redaction checklist 3) Schedule enablement + handoff doc for their infra team.
Jin (SolutionsEng): I'll run a quick compatibility check. If they want 1536 dims, we'll likely use our quantized 8-bit path. Est. GPU: 1xA10G for 100 rps with batching.
Jin (SolutionsEng): Sample config I'm proposing: ```model: willow-custom-embed-v1
dims: 1536
precision: int8
batch_sizes: [4,8,16]
cache: prefix_kv:false
routing: private-vpc-region-us-west-2
```
Priya (Safety): For evals, plan: 1) redaction recall/precision on their 200 examples 2) hallucination/regeneration tests on 50 prompts 3) stress test with mixed PII/PHI. Need to decide pass thresholds.
Aisha (CSM): For renewal risk: this feature is a stickiness play. If onboarding slips >3 weeks they'll flag timelines. Let's keep a 2-week delivery target after we get the labeled data.

onboard-bot: New onboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/1745556667 (assigned to Jin, Priya, Aisha)
Marco (Willow): Thanks — when can we get an ETA on the safety eval plan?
Priya (Safety): I can draft the eval matrix by EOD Friday. Will include threshold suggestions: redaction recall >= 0.95, false redaction <= 0.02.
Jin (SolutionsEng): I'll do a perf run on a representative model snapshot once they share the model tar + tokenizer. ETA Monday.
Aisha (CSM): I'll schedule a 30m enablement with their infra lead for Tuesday 10am PT. Sending invite now.
Marco (Willow): Invite received. Also confirm HSM support — they require key rotation every 90 days.
Jin (SolutionsEng): We support KMS/HSM integrations on Private — will add notes to the handoff. Jin: @Priya can you include HSM compliance checks for the safety playbook?
Priya (Safety): Yep — adding key rotation and audit log checks.
Aisha (CSM): Closing loop: who's writing the customer-facing onboarding doc? I'll draft the initial the timeline + requirements and drop in the onboarding doc link.
Marco (Willow): Sounds good. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Aisha (CSM): Updated the checklist with milestones and risk flags. If anything slips I’ll ping eng leadership.
Jin (SolutionsEng): Quick note: if we hit memory pressure with 1536 dims at int8 we may recommend 4-bit quant or shard across 2 GPUs. Will report after perf run.
Priya (Safety): Also request their retention policy for embeddings — determines if we need to apply additional lifecycle rules.
Marco (Willow): They keep embeddings for 30 days by default, can change if needed.
Aisha (CSM): Perfect — I’ll record that in the renewal playbook. Follow-ups: Jin (perf) by Mon, Priya (eval matrix) by Fri, Aisha (doc + invite) done.
Marco (Willow): Great. Will prepare the labeled set and model artifact share link.

onboard-bot: Reminder: post the eval results to the thread and tag @Priya within 24hrs of completion.
